
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lizhaoyao/p/19094835" title="发布于 2025-09-16 15:19">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">ruoyi-vue初步接触</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>因为最近参加了一个比赛，培训的时候说最终考试是要求使用ruoyi-vue来做功能，于是我在网上找到了ruoyi这个项目，准备给他搭建起来。</p>
<p>找了一下官网 发现了这个 <a href="https://doc.ruoyi.vip/ruoyi/document/hjbs.html#%E5%87%86%E5%A4%87%E5%B7%A5%E4%BD%9C" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">准备工作</a></p>
<p>&nbsp;然后我就开始查看本机环境</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>java --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">version
openjdk </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">21.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2025</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">07</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">15</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
OpenJDK Runtime Environment (build </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">21.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>+<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9</span>-Ubuntu-0ubuntu122.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">04.1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
OpenJDK </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">64</span>-Bit Server VM (build <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">21.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>+<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9</span>-Ubuntu-0ubuntu122.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">04.1</span>, mixed mode, sharing)</pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>mysql --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">version
mysql  Ver </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8.0</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">43</span>-0ubuntu0.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">22.04</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> Linux on x86_64 ((Ubuntu))</pre>
</div>
<p>还有个 Maven ，我发现这个我没有，就赶紧去装一个 还是apt命令老一套</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sudo</span> apt <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> maven</pre>
</div>
<p>然后看看版本</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>mvn --<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">version
Apache Maven </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3.6</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
Maven home: </span>/usr/share/maven</pre>
</div>
<p>好了，然后去克隆<a href="https://gitee.com/y_project/RuoYi" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">仓库</a></p>
<p>就 git clone 呗</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>git clone https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">gitee.com/y_project/RuoYi.git</span></pre>
</div>
<p>然后，就是来到仓库下面，给那个&nbsp;ruoyi-admin/src/main/resources/application-druid.yml 文件里面的连接数据库的信息改改，就是这段</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            master:
                url: jdbc:mysql:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">localhost:3306/ry-vue?useUnicode=true&amp;characterEncoding=utf8&amp;zeroDateTimeBehavior=convertToNull&amp;useSSL=true&amp;serverTimezone=GMT%2B8</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                username: root
                password: root</span></pre>
</div>
<p>配置完了，就把数据库也对应的导入一下。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>mysql<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&gt;</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">create</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">database</span> `ry<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">-</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">vue` charset utf8mb4;
Query OK, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">1</span> row affected (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">0.03</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sec)

mysql</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&gt;</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">use</span> `ry<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">-</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">vue`
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">Database</span> changed</pre>
</div>
<p>然后导进去数据库文件&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">mysql<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&gt;</span> source <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">/</span>home<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">/</span>zhaoyao<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">/</span>script<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">/</span>java<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">/</span>RuoYi<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">-</span>Vue<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">/</span>sql<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">/</span>ry_20250522.sql;</span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>好了，然后数据库创建好了。</p>

<p>说明这一步成功了，然后有可能中间提示什么没有ruoyi的文件夹来记录日志，那你手动创建一个 并且给权限就好了。</p>
<p>然后来到后端&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>cd ruoyi-admin/target</pre>
</div>
<p>再执行&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>java -jar ruoyi-admin.jar</pre>
</div>
<p>就看到了如下效果</p>

</div>
<p>这说明后端启动成功，然后再开个命令行窗口来到前端&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">cd ruoyi-ui/</span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>先执行</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>npm <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span></pre>
</div>
<p>再执行</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>npm run dev</pre>
</div>
<p>如果提示说&nbsp;vue-cli-service 没权限 那你就给他加可执行权限就行</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">chmod</span> +x node_modules/.bin/vue-cli-service</pre>
</div>
<p>如果运行成功，会自动打开浏览器，就是这个界面</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/704203/202509/704203-20250916151406673-1185789881.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>如果失败是有可能提示，ENOSPC: System limit for number of file watchers reached</p>
<p>那就按下面的做，不过这个重启后失效</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># 临时将 max_user_watches 设置为 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">524288</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sudo</span> sysctl fs.inotify.max_user_watches=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">524288</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
# 使更改立即生效
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sudo</span> sysctl -p</pre>
</div>
<p>想要永久生效，得改那个文件&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">/etc/sysctl.conf</span>&nbsp;，里面增加一行&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">fs.inotify.max_user_watches=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">524288</span></span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>然后，好了，你就可以用这套系统了，这套系统总体来说上手难度不大，还能自动生成代码，也还是不错的。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<div class="clear"></div>
